Current and archived flood information has moved to its own page.
Click here to view the 2026 flood page.
The Commissioners will be in open session on September 24, 2026 starting at 10:00 AM to discuss office relocation plans with the OSU Extension Office.
The Morgan County Auditor's Office has an opening for a Deputy Auditor. This posting is for an in-person office position at the Riecker Building, located at 155 E. Main St. in McConnelsville. Click the here for more details about the Deputy Auditor position.
-->
There will be a public meeting concerning the Cipher Mining Data Center Project on Wednesday, June 17, 2026 at 6:00 PM at the Morgan High School Auditorium.
Check the Commissioners' Facebook page for more details.
-->
The Morgan County Records Commission will meet on Monday, June 15, 2026 at 8:00 AM in the Commissioners' Office (The Riecker Building, Room 216).
-->
The OFFICIAL results of the May 5, 2026 Special Primary Election are now available on the Morgan County Board of Elections website. Click here for details.
-->
The Morgan County Land Reutilization Corporation's 2025 Annual Financial Reports were filed in the Hinkle Annual Financial Data Reporting System on March 30, 2026. The financial statements are available for inspection in the Morgan County Treasurer's Office.
-->
Buckeye Southeast Transit is seeking van washing services at its three locations.
Quotes need to be in a sealed envelope and be received at the Morgan County Economic Development Office 155 E. Main St. Room 135 McConnelsville, Ohio 43756 by April 10, 2026 at 3:00p.m. Click here for details.
-->
The Morgan County Commissioners' Office is seeking quotes for lawn care at Buckeye Southeast Transit, the Morgan County Health Department, and the Morgan County Dog Pound. Quotes should be submitted by March 30, 2026. Click here for details.
-->
Morgan County Common Pleas Court Juvenile and Probate Divisions, as well as the Clerk of Courts' Office, will close on Friday, February 20th, 2026 at 12:30 p.m. to allow staff to attend calling hours for retired Sheriff Tom Jenkins.
Court offices will reopen as soon as staff are able to return after paying their respects.
Thank you for your understanding.
-->
Morgan County Ohio Commissioners are currently seeking Request for Qualifications (RFQ) for a Guaranteed Energy Savings Contract. Click here for details.
-->
Click here for the new Morgan County Transportation Plan for 2027 to 2031.
As required by the Ohio Administrative Code (OAC), rule 5180:3-1-26, click here for Morgan County's Memorandum of Understanding to Address Child Abuse and Neglect.
Dog tags are now available for purchase for 2026 and will be available until the end of February 2026. Click for more details.
-->
The OFFICIAL results of the November 4, 2025 General Election are now available on the Morgan County Board of Elections' website. Click below to see the OFFICIAL results for Morgan County.
2025 OFFICIAL Election Results
-->
The Morgan County Treasurer's Office will be closed October 22â€“23, 2025, to allow staff to attend training. During this time, tax payments may be submitted online at www.morgancountytreasurer.org or by check or money order placed in the orange drop-box located next to the front door on the Main Street side of the Riecker Building
-->
Starting on Monday, August 4, 2025, the Morgan County Courthouse will only be accessible via the basement door on the Kennebec Avenue side of the building.
-->
Are you looking for current requests for proposals (RFPs) for professional services from the Morgan County Commissioners' Office? Click here to go to the new RFP page to view current and past RFPs. The posted date as well as the due date will also now be shown for each request for proposal when they are placed online.
Click here for the temporary Morgan County Public Transit page.
-->
The Morgan County Land Bank page is now online.
Click this link to view information about the Morgan County Land Bank.
The Morgan County Commissioners' Office is accepting sealed bids for the installation of a generator and transfer switch at Morgan County Public Transit.
Bid must be received by 10 AM on Monday, February 3, 2025.
Click here for project details.
-->
The OFFICIAL 2024 General Election results are now available on the Morgan County Board of Elections' website. Click below to see the OFFICIAL results for Morgan County.
2024 OFFICIAL Election Results
-->
Check the Drought Information page for all drought related updates.
-->
Morgan County Health Department Survey
Click HERE for a printable copy of the survey. This can be returned to the Morgan County Health Department.
-->
The Morgan County Department of Job and Family Services will be accepting bids for the Kinship Program. Sealed bids must be received by 3 p.m. on September 13, 2024. Bids will be opened at 3 p.m. on September 16, 2024. Click this link to see the entire Public Notice.
-->
E-Waste recycling is coming to Morgan County on August 8, 2024. The drop off location will be at the baseball fields in Malta and they will be accepting items from 9:00 a.m. until 3:00 p.m. Check out the poster for details.
-->
Below is a public notice from the Morgan County Engineer's Office concerning building permit requirements:
Resolution 23-549: Building Permit Requirements in Floodplain
Morgan County is accepting quotes for lawn care services at the Morgan County Public Transit, Morgan County Health Department, and the Morgan County Dog Pound locations. Please see the attached form for details.
Morgan County 2024 Lawncare Quotes
-->
The Morgan County Children Services Board (MCCS) is issuing a Request for Proposals (RFP) that will solicit qualified individuals or organizations interested in providing managed case aid services to Morgan County Children Services staff.
Click the link below to view the RFP.
MCCS Request for Proposals
-->
The Morgan County Commissioners' Office is looking for an Apiary Inspector. The Apiary Inspector would work with beekeepers within the county to ensure colony health as well as curtail the spread of diseases and pests. The full details of the position can be found below. Interested parties can contact the Morgan County Commissioners' Office at 740-962-3183.
Apiary Inspector Details
-->
Click below for the final report that was submitted to the Commissioners' Office from the Reid Consulting Group on the State's Rural Broadband Initiative.
RCG Final Report
-->
REGISTER YOUR NEED FOR HIGH-SPEED INTERNET ACCESS TODAY! The state and federal governments are working on funding for rural high-speed Internet access now. If your area does not have high-speed Internet access, take THIS SURVEY to report this to Connecting Appalachia. You can also report your Internet speed by testing it HERE .
-->
We have streamlined the process for renting the Riecker Building's Community Room. Reservations can now be sent in and confirmed via e-mail. See the new Community Room page for details.
The status of upcoming jury trials can now be viewed on the new Jury Information page. This new page will provide a backup to the voicemail-based juror line that is typically employed to relay information to jurors.
